decision: Can input-only routing keep the earlier structured-data backbone distinct from the preserved general assistant, while retaining both learned knowledge experts?
scope: Development routing across four already available numerical paths, using the same source identities and split. No new LLM weights, sealed quality result or promotion. Structured and general held-out questions must all keep their intended model.
context: User turns joined in conversation order. System messages and all assistant text, including the reference response, are excluded.
stop_rule: Record the result before choosing any change. Do not use historical final tests to tune this development router.
